dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Rune is at risk due to behavioral reasons. While in care, Rune has been highly reluctant to exit kennel and is very fearful. Rune has been observed to be frozen and trembling while in kennel. When a hook is used to remove the leash, Rune will bark, vocalize, and nip at the hook. With a slow approach Rune is receptive to coaxing and high-value treats. Medically, Rune has allergies, alopecia, and is overweight.

Rune arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Rune has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to be frozen and trembling while in kennel. Due to the detailed behavior we recommend an experienced adult only home.
